LESSON: FUNCTIONAL WRITING

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: GERMAN
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.1: Functional writing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 1

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Functional writing, part of Strand 3 in Grade 6 GERMAN.

Key inquiry question: Why do you write?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. make a profile with name and age,

2. write short texts to introduce themselves (z.B. Ich heiße_____/ich bin_____/Mein Name ist_____; ich bin ____ Jahre alt)

3. write profiles of peers (z.B. Das ist ___; Er/sie ist ___ Jahre alt),

4. fill in cloze tests.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. make a profile with name and age,
2. write short texts to introduce themselves (z.B. Ich heiße_____/ich bin_____/Mein Name ist_____; ich bin ____ Jahre alt)
3. write profiles of peers (z.B. Das ist ___; Er/sie ist ___ Jahre alt),
4. fill in cloze tests.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Functional writing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Self-efficacy: Learner develops the skill of knowing who s/he is when s/he makes own and peers’ profiles.

Values:
Respect: Learner observes etiquette as s/he works with peers in pairs to introduce each other and find out about

others.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Citizenship: Learner develops awareness for the role of greetings and introduction in maintaining social cohesion.

Link to other Learning Areas: Learner relates the concept of greetings, self- and others’ introduction with similar

concept in English and Kiswahili.
